# Third-party SVGs used to test SVG import (phase 6, step 1)

Retrieved 14 November 2026. These are not Gertie's work. They are test inputs only.

**Licence status: not confirmed for either file. Do not commit or redistribute them until it is.**
Check each site's terms, then either record the licence here or replace the file.

| File | Source | Size | Looks like (from the file itself) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `w3c-illustration-1.svg` | https://design-system.w3.org/dist/assets/svg/illustration-1.svg | 31,342 bytes | Sketch export, run through SVGO: short ids (`a`, `c`), `fill-rule="evenodd"`, `<mask>` and `<use>`, nested `transform="translate()"` |
| `pinegrow-code-collaboration.svg` | https://pinegrow.com/wp-content/uploads/Code-collaboration.svg | 86,436 bytes | Illustrator-style export: `id="Layer_1"`, `x="0px"`, `enable-background`, 327 paths, 5 linear gradients, no transforms |

The "looks like" column is an inference from the markup, not a statement from the authors.
Neither file is from Figma or Inkscape, so step 1's acceptance (Figma, Illustrator, Inkscape) still needs those two.
